revealed.decision_rule: Untrained means the same-binary rerun (primary control, shared with EXP-CZ-010); EXP-CZ-009's ledgers are a secondary reference reported beside it. Holm is over m = 9 hypotheses in each family: the eight counted members plus the excluded Graham entered at p = 1. H11.1 is supported if at least five members show a Holm-significant (m = 9) gain over the untrained member. H11.2 has no direction: the result is the number of members significantly better each way after Holm (m = 9). H11.3 holds if no counted member's E2 falls more than 2 points (24 tasks) below the untrained member. Graham is not counted (parity gate) and enters each family as an untested hypothesis at p = 1. Every number comes from cz paired with experiments/EXP-CZ-011/analysis_plan.json (the self-taught runs are EXP-CZ-010's).
revealed.failure_criteria: A run is void, and reported, if its ledger fails verification, its result JSON disagrees with the ledger (root, solves, tokens), its tasks_sha256 differs from sealed set 2, its model_id, template, weight_sha256 or adapter_sha256 differs from this manifest, it is not greedy, or it lacks one verdict per task. A void run counts as an untested hypothesis (p = 1) in its Holm family and cannot support any hypothesis. The driver refuses to run a row whose served file, base GGUF, runner or sealed file differs from the frozen sha256.
hypotheses: H11.1 For at least five of the nine members, the outside-taught member solves more sealed tasks than the untrained member (exact McNemar, Holm over nine, alpha 0.05).
H11.2 Outside-taught versus self-taught, per member: exact McNemar, Holm over nine, two-sided. No direction is predicted; the count of members significantly better each way is the result.
H11.3 Format validity (E2) of the outside-taught member does not fall more than 2 points below the untrained member for any member.
revealed.primary_endpoint: Per member, the paired difference in sealed set 2 solves, outside-taught minus untrained (H11.1) and outside-taught minus self-taught (H11.2), each with exact two-sided McNemar and Holm adjustment over the nine members (alpha 0.05). E1 to E4 as in EXP-CZ-001 for each outside-taught member. Cost (reported): teacher requests, tokens and USD from the proxy ledger, kept examples, GPU minutes for training, adapter bytes.
revealed.title: Outside teacher: one teacher-taught adapter per founding member, paired against the untrained and the self-taught member on sealed set 2
